evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: For 'Создаём и защищаем учётную запись GitHub', the learner can git vs GitHub distinction, installation on Linux/Windows/macOS, first-time config (user.name/email, init.defaultBranch), GitHub account setup, HTTPS vs SSH authentication, SSH key generation, cloning the real safesort repo, origin/remote model, working tree/staging/commit/branch/HEAD model.
Git works fully locally, no account/network required; GitHub is a separate networked service built on top of Git (one-directional dependency) -- confirmed accurate

macOS: no single official git-scm.com installer since Git 2.33.0 (2021); Xcode CLT / Homebrew / MacPorts are third-party-maintained alternatives -- confirmed accurate and matches git-scm.com's own current stated position

Git 2.28 added the init.defaultBranch *setting*, not new default behavior — a bare `git init` with no config still creates `master` -- confirmed accurate and unusually precise; correctly distinguishes the option's existence from its effect
SSH key generation uses `ssh-keygen -t ed25519`, the current GitHub-recommended key type (not legacy RSA) -- confirmed current best practice
`ssh -T git@github.com` 'does not provide shell access' message is explicitly explained as success, not an error -- confirmed accurate

Password-over-HTTPS for git push is described as no longer working; PAT via credential helper or `gh auth login` required -- confirmed accurate (GitHub removed password auth for Git operations in 2021)

`git clone https://github.com/Cartesian-School/safesort.git` terminal capture and `git log --oneline -5` output (build_git_08, lines ~1017-1032) showing 5 real commit hashes/messages -- confirmed via `gh api repos/Cartesian-School/safesort/commits`: all 5 short hashes (fe610cf, c376fba, 01989e0, 29c6328, c5e34d5) and full commit-message text are byte-identical to the live repository
Working tree / staging / commit / branch / HEAD / origin model, `git fetch` vs `git pull` vs `git push` distinction -- confirmed accurate, standard Git model correctly explained
